title: Port operations slowed after terminal equipment outage
summary: A terminal operator reported reduced container throughput at Long Beach while crane systems are inspected. The notice gives no confirmed restoration time.

title: Northstar reroutes two inbound containers
summary: Two purchase orders due this week show a revised arrival estimate after a carrier route change. The feed does not identify the downstream production lines.

title: Regional power conservation notice issued in Monterrey
summary: The utility requests industrial customers to reduce discretionary load for 24 hours. No facility-specific outage has been confirmed.

title: Quarterly filing notes planned maintenance window
summary: A routine maintenance window is planned next month. Current customer deliveries are not reported as affected.

title: Supplier contract renewal remains unconfirmed
summary: A renewal decision is due in 20 days. No interruption notice has been found; the status needs confirmation from the account owner.
